q: Antara rasional Peraturan USECHH 2000 ialah:
c: Menetapkan standard pendedahan di tempat kerja
e: Rationale: legal framework to control hazardous chemicals, set workplace exposure standard, promote excellent management, prevent occupational disease/poisoning.

q: Bahagian X USECHH 2000 berkaitan dengan:
c: Perlindungan Penyingkiran Perubatan (Medical Removal Protection)
e: Salient provision: Part VIII Monitoring, Part IX Health Surveillance, Part X Medical Removal Protection, Part XI Warning Sign, Part XII Record Keeping.

q: Senarai bahan kimia yang memerlukan pengawasan perubatan terdapat dalam:
c: Jadual II USECHH
e: Schedule I: PEL; Schedule II: chemicals for which medical surveillance is appropriate; Schedule III: information on pesticide.

q: USECHH terpakai kepada:
c: Semua tempat kerja di bawah OSHA 1994 yang menggunakan bahan kimia berbahaya kepada kesihatan
e: Application: all places of work within the purview of OSHA 1994 where chemicals hazardous to health are used.

q: Sesuatu bahan termasuk dalam takrif CHH jika ia:
c: Tersenarai dalam Jadual Pertama Peraturan Kualiti Alam Sekeliling (Buangan Terjadual) 1989
e: CHH: listed in Schedule I/II, properties in Part B Schedule I CPL 1997, pesticide under Pesticides Act, or listed in First Schedule of EQ (Scheduled Wastes) Regulations 1989.

q: Daftar bahan kimia di bawah Peraturan 5(2) perlu mengandungi:
c: Purata kuantiti penggunaan, kawasan kerja dan nama serta alamat pembekal
e: Identification (Reg. 5(2)): list of CHH, current CSDS, average quantity used, process/work area, name and address of supplier.

q: Penilai (assessor) bagi penilaian risiko kesihatan mestilah:
c: Dilantik oleh majikan dan berdaftar dengan Ketua Pengarah JKKP
e: The Assessor (Reg. 11): employee/any other person appointed by employer and registered with DG of DOSH.

q: Laporan penilaian risiko kesihatan perlu menyatakan, antara lain:
c: Keperluan program pemantauan pendedahan dan pengawasan kesihatan
e: Assessment shall contain: nature of hazard, degree of exposure, control measures, accidental emission control, necessity of exposure monitoring and health surveillance, training needs.

q: Jika penilaian menunjukkan bahaya serta-merta kepada nyawa atau harta, penilai perlu:
c: Memaklumkan majikan dengan segera
e: If the assessment indicates any immediate danger to life or property, the assessor shall immediately inform the employer.

q: Penutupan sepenuhnya (total enclosure) proses dan sistem pengendalian ialah contoh:
c: Langkah kawalan pendedahan bahan kimia
e: Control measures: elimination, substitution, total enclosure, isolation, process modification, engineering control, safe work systems, PPE.

q: Amalan dan sistem kerja selamat perlu dikaji semula apabila:
c: Terdapat perubahan ketara pada proses, peralatan, bahan atau langkah kawalan
e: Employer shall ensure safe work systems are documented, implemented and reviewed whenever there is a significant change.

q: Bekas bahan kimia yang labelnya tertanggal, rosak atau diubah perlu:
c: Dilabel semula
e: Labelling (Reg. 20): all containers properly labelled; relabelled if removed, defaced, modified or altered.

q: Di makmal ujian kimia, bekas bahan kimia perlu dilabel semula:
c: Sama ada kandungan digunakan dalam syif biasa atau tidak
e: Relabelling (Reg. 21): if chemicals used in a testing laboratory, container shall be relabelled whether or not used within normal shift.

q: Maklumat, arahan dan penyeliaan di bawah Peraturan 23 perlu diberikan kepada:
c: Pekerja dan sesiapa yang menjalankan kerja berkaitan bahan kimia untuk majikan
e: Reg. 23: given by employer to employee & any person who carries out work connected to the employer involving CHH.

q: CSDS atau salinannya perlu (Peraturan 25):
c: Disimpan berdekatan kawasan kerja kimia dan mudah diakses pekerja
e: Provision of CSDS (Reg. 25): kept close to chemical work area; easily accessible to employees.

q: Pemantauan pendedahan di tempat kerja (Peraturan 26) mestilah dijalankan:
c: Menggunakan kaedah dan analisis yang diluluskan
e: Monitoring (Reg. 26): ensure control measures adequate; carried out using approved method and analysis.

q: Pekerja hamil atau menyusu yang terdedah kepada bahan kimia berbahaya, apabila dimaklumkan oleh OHD:
c: Tidak boleh dibenarkan bekerja dalam pendedahan tersebut
e: Medical Removal Protection (Reg. 28): shall not allow pregnant or breast feeding employee exposed to CHH to work when notified by OHD/medical practitioner.

q: Papan tanda amaran USECHH perlu dipasang:
c: Di tempat yang jelas di setiap pintu masuk kawasan berbahaya
e: Warning sign (Reg. 29): posted at a conspicuous place at every entrance of the area to warn persons entering.

q: Jika majikan menutup perniagaan dan tiada pengganti, rekod USECHH perlu:
c: Diserahkan kepada Ketua Pengarah
e: Record keeping (Reg. 30): hand over records to successor; transmit to DG if no successor; notify DG 3 months before disposal.

q: Garis panduan di bawah USECHH termasuk:
c: Garis panduan penyediaan Daftar Bahan Kimia
e: Guidelines: registration of assessor, hygiene technician and OHD; preparation of chemical register; control of CHH; medical surveillance; assessment of health risks (CHRA).
